entries.title: Share cards
entries.summary: Link previews for invites, high scores, run ranks and journeys, drawn by the Worker and cached in R2.
entries.statusNote: Deployed; kept paused with the other paid services in the last recorded operator receipt (2026-09-29).

entries.title: Docent model bake-off
entries.summary: A held-out question set, an evaluation runner and a dry run for choosing the docent’s model on its own sources.
entries.statusNote: An offline evaluation tool; the docent itself answers with claude-haiku-4-5.

entries.title: Explicit analytics
entries.summary: A first-party endpoint forwards an allow-list of game events to PostHog. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured, and an English and Japanese page lets players opt out.
entries.statusNote: Configured on in production (TELEMETRY_INGEST=1, PR #8); paused in the last recorded operator receipt (2026-09-29).

entries.title: Lessons with Pip
entries.summary: Short lesson pages for young children, led by Pip in the Sky Islands theme, with rounds, hints and recorded voice lines. Pip gates and locked bridges put the same questions inside the maze.
entries.statusNote: Live at /learn (PRs #9, #12, #48). The voice lines were generated once, offline, with ElevenLabs through AI Gateway; players hear the stored recordings.

entries.title: URL catalog and content review
entries.summary: Every captured site is kept in a durable catalog with private evidence. A new capture waits for a person to approve it in the operator’s review console before anyone else can play it.
entries.statusNote: Live in manual review mode (MODERATION_MODE=manual, PR #13). An automatic classifier exists in the code and is switched off.

entries.title: Bridge Builders lesson slice
entries.summary: The first slice of a longer lesson plan: a lesson document format, a session reducer and session storage on the device.
entries.statusNote: Merged with its sampler hidden (PR #14); the later milestones were not built.

entries.title: Operator workbench and Jev
entries.summary: An Access-protected console where the operator reviews captures, costs and restarts, and Jev, a TypeSafe AI agent that plays mazes for the operator to watch, under a daily spending cap.
entries.statusNote: Operator only (PRs #16, #18, #38, #40). Jev calls TypeSafe’s API directly, is off by default and was paused in the last recorded receipt.

entries.title: Race mode
entries.summary: A third way to play: fourteen authored courses with island jumps, earned and stacked turbo, three lives, climbs and descents, and a ghost of your own best run kept on the device.
entries.statusNote: On in production (VITE_RACE_ENABLED, PRs #17 and #42). Physical-phone and human playtest gates are still open.

entries.title: Cost controls
entries.summary: A monthly budget for paid services. Each paid job is admitted against it, optional services pause as it fills, and new paid work stops before the cap. The operator can pause services by hand, and offline practice makes no API calls.

entries.title: Performance programme
entries.summary: Quality adapts to measured frame times, unused graphics memory is released, ghost preparation and audio synthesis run off the main thread, screenshot storage is bounded, input recordings are compact, and idle or hidden pages do less work.
entries.statusNote: Merged in PR #34; each change records its own measurements.

entries.title: Play on one phone
entries.summary: No second screen needed: an on-screen stick with Jump, Turbo and Pause, then tilt to steer and tap to jump, and a layout repaired for small screens.
entries.statusNote: On in production (VITE_MOBILE_CONTROLS_ENABLED and VITE_MOBILE_TILT_ENABLED; PRs #41–#44, #46, #49 and #51).

entries.title: Faster home page
entries.summary: The home page is usable before the game loads: the game code is fetched afterwards and the title artwork is cached.

entries.title: Lesson depth and family progress
entries.summary: Lessons gained objectives and fresh examples on every play. Progress is kept on the device and, for a signed-in family, synced to a parent account; the maze records the same evidence at Pip gates.
entries.statusNote: PR #50. Family accounts are open to an allow-list only (LEARNING_ACCOUNTS=allowlist) until the privacy and educator reviews. An operator-only drafting agent (claude-sonnet-5-5 through AI Gateway) writes lesson drafts that a person reviews.

entries.title: Portal windows
entries.summary: See the next site through a link portal before you go: a postcard of the page, a tear you push through, then a cut into that site’s intro.
entries.statusNote: Merged (PRs #52, #56); on in PR previews only (VITE_PORTAL_WINDOWS_ENABLED) until the production sign-off in PR #57.

entries.title: Keeping this record current
entries.summary: This “Since launch” list, a refreshed account of what exists today for the docent, and a report on every pull request that says where this record has fallen behind the work.
entries.statusNote: The pull-request report is advisory: it comments and never blocks a merge.
